svg.title: Axelrod World Model: learning, inference, and the architecture
svg.desc: One causal world model of the economy, built like version control. Backend users teach it: each event's learning is staged, a person checks every change down to the third-order ripple, and only what they approve is committed. Everyone else asks it: a thesis runs on a branch that is never merged.
